"Trump responds to Tusk's remarks about 'friendship' with Putin": Trump dismissed the criticism from the Polish Prime Minister and stated that he has known Putin for many years. "During a meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, Trump greeted Putin with a friendly joke and called him 'my friend.' Tusk reacted sharply to the statement on social media. In a phone call with Fox News correspondent Aisha Hasni near the White House, Trump dismissed this criticism. 'Well, I can't do anything about it. I've known him for a long time. It's fine. I like the Polish Prime Minister. Don't forget, I supported him,' Trump said. He added that Tusk won thanks to his support. Trump also confirmed that Putin had launched drones into Poland and a couple of small rockets, but by mistake. The conversation with Hasni took place during Trump's flight from China to Washington on Air Force One. When asked about what his speech on Friday would be about, Trump replied that he would talk about the successes of his trip to China. 'I'll just explain how amazing this trip was. It was incredible, unprecedented, and, I have to say, the press covered it very well,' Trump said." @Slavyangrad
